name: Rice Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: quarters of a pound of sugar
ingredients.originalText: three quarters of a pound of sugar

ingredients.name: quarters of a pound of melted butter
ingredients.originalText: three quarters of a pound of melted butter

instructions.text: Boil half a pound of rice in milk, until it is quite tender
Beat it well with a wooden spoon to mash the grains
Add three quarters of a pound of sugar, and the same of melted butter
Add half a nutmeg, six eggs, a gill of wine, and some grated lemon peel
Put a paste in the dish, and bake it
For change, it may be boiled, and eaten with butter, sugar, and wine

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil half a pound of rice in milk, until it is quite tender
2. Beat it well with a wooden spoon to mash the grains
3. Add three quarters of a pound of sugar, and the same of melted butter
4. Add half a nutmeg, six eggs, a gill of wine, and some grated lemon peel
5. Put a paste in the dish, and bake it
6. For change, it may be boiled, and eaten with butter, sugar, and wine
